crossRefs.note: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.
Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, who are far from righteousness!
Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways…
He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.
Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
Then Yahweh’s angel went out and struck one hundred and eighty-five thousand men in the camp of the Assyrians. When men…
When they are heated, I will make their feast, and I will make them drunk, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual…
Your shepherds slumber, king of Assyria. Your nobles lie down. Your people are scattered on the mountains, and there is…
“The Assyrian will fall by the sword, not of man; and the sword, not of mankind, shall devour him. He will flee from…
“Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. Behold, it has not been bound up, to apply medicines, to…

translations.web: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.
translations.bsb: The valiant lie plundered; they sleep their last sleep. No men of might could lift a hand.
translations.kjv: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
translations.asv: The stouthearted are made a spoil, They have slept their sleep; And none of the men of might have found their hands.
